description: The supplied file is a Flutter Dart application implementing a hearing frequency range checker. It includes the main app setup, UI components, state management for the hearing test process, tone generation and playback, and history tracking of test results.

classes.name: HearingTestResult
classes.description: Model class representing a hearing test result with minimum and maximum frequencies heard and the timestamp.

classes.name: TestHomePage
classes.description: Main widget managing the UI and state for the hearing test process.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter bindings, locks orientation to portrait, and runs the app.

methods.name: _startTest
methods.description: Begins a new hearing test session, resetting relevant state.

methods.name: _playCurrentTone
methods.description: Generates and plays the tone at the current test frequency.

methods.name: _sineWaveWavBytes
methods.description: Static method that generates a WAV byte array representing a sine wave at a specified frequency.

methods.name: _onUserHeard
methods.description: Handles user input on whether they heard the tone, progressing the test to the next frequency or finalizing results.

methods.name: _handleTestCompletion
methods.description: Calculates min and max audible frequencies based on user responses and saves the result.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the test state to the initial screen.
